dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Please, friend, stay. It's not the time to go to Poisson, so please come back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: I'm with Spina di Rosula. As you can see, the town's suffered flooding recently, and it's a total mess.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: While the waters have receded for now, no one knows what's going to happen. Perhaps you also know of the "prophecy"...

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Anyway, the townspeople have already evacuated. No help is needed right now, so you should really get out of here too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Yep. The water's been unstable these days, so it's best if you just leave. Quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Hello, do you need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: I'm with Spina di Rosula. I mainly used to work in the Court of Fontaine, but the Boss sent me here a while ago.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: I'm sure you know that the town was flooded. I've come to help the people here rebuild their homes.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Ah, though they've lost so much, most of them are staying strong. They even care about me being tired...

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: To be honest, after getting to know everyone, I don't really want to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No need, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Hmm. The road's still not in great shape, so please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: I would have never discovered my gift for fishing if I hadn't moved to Poisson.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're...

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Hello, I'm with the Spina di Rosula. I used to work in the Court of Fontaine until the Boss sent me here.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: I'm sure you know that the town was flooded. I came over then to help the people here rebuild their homes.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Take a look for yourself! The rebuilt Poisson is quite beautiful, huh? And that's why I moved here with the intention of settling down.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: Everyone here is so friendly, and they even taught me how to fish and dive... Well, this is the birthplace of the Spina after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Vincenzo
dialogues.text: See you. It's pretty nice here in town, so you should stay for a while.
